bestBets.overview: Bit of an average 1600m C1 to kick off proceedings here at Hawkesbury. The Richard Litt-trained PHILATELIC goes on top, three consistent runs all resulting in placings, peaks fitness-wise and gets a white-hot Zac Lloyd in the saddle from a good gate. HITCH broke through for his maiden win last time out. That race has produced a subsequent winner since and the rise now to 1600m suits. I AM BRAVE is slowly working her way to a win. Up to 1500m last time out produced her best run for the prep, an extra 100m can only aid. COSTABIT draws well but does need to improve here if he is to win.

raceTips.comment: Phillatelic has been racing consistently this preparation and looks suited by the way this race sets up, with enough tactical speed to settle in a prominent position. The gelding has shown a good turn of foot when produced at the right time and should have every chance to finish strongly. I Am Brave has been competitive in similar company and possesses the early pace to hold a handy position from the outset. The filly looks capable of finding the line strongly if she gets clear running in the straight. Costabit has shown enough ability in recent outings to be considered a genuine each-way chance. The gelding maps for a comfortable run and should appreciate getting some cover before being produced late. Hitch has scope to improve again and can be dangerous if able to settle close enough to the speed.

bestBets.overview: The staying event of the program as a solid enough field tackle the 2000m here. The locally trained PREFER DIAMONDS is the horse to beat. She brings smart Midway form from her last start in town, a drop back in class and looks hard to beat. No real speed to report up front, GREEN PINEAPPLE goes in the mix coming off back-to-back recent wins. Small field here and this progressive galloper can position up well enough from the wide draw. The veteran DR EVIL and FAY?S ANGELS bring mixed form to this event but both will enjoy the steep drop back in class. A win wouldn?t surprise.

raceTips.comment: Green Apple looks well placed to produce another competitive performance and has the racing pattern to take up a favourable position. The gelding has shown good acceleration when asked for an effort and should be suited if the tempo is genuine. Prefer Diamonds has been holding her form well and brings a solid profile into this contest. The mare can settle just off the speed and has the ability to sustain a strong run to the line. Binkou has shown glimpses of ability and looks capable of making his presence felt with the right run. The gelding should be kept safe around the money if he gets the necessary room at the business end.

bestBets.overview: Intriguing race. Solid speed expected up front which suits the talented POWER BROKER down to the ground. He got a long way back in a high-rating debut contest, smart late sectionals as he savaged the line. Straight to 1500m here suits, the gate though is the query. COMANCHE CHIEF comes through the same race as Power Broker. He?s a run in front of that horse and does have a smart map advantage here. The Sara Ryan-trained RED DEER goes in the mix. 0/12 doesn?t read the best but I dare say this is an easier task than last start. Race fit and can land forward of midfield. WARM FRONT rounds out the numbers with Alysha Collett in the saddle.

raceTips.comment: Red Deet has impressed with the strength of his recent efforts and looks ideally suited stepping into this company. The gelding possesses a good cruising speed and should be able to settle within striking distance of the leaders. Power Broker has continued to race consistently and brings the right form into this contest. The gelding has enough tactical speed to avoid being caught too far away from the action and should be strong late. Comanche Chief has shown plenty of fight in his recent performances and remains a serious contender. The gelding can roll forward and make his own luck if the opportunity presents. Gold Earth has been competitive without having everything go his way and looks capable of improving his position here. The gelding should be hitting the line strongly if able to secure cover during the run.

bestBets.overview: Big field here for what shapes to be a cracking 1100m maiden. I'm going to put the Edward O'Rourke-trained CLINGER POWER on top here at EW odds, the booking of Lloyd is key and I have been impressed by her two trials to date. BEYOND THE REEF is the danger, second prep, smart trials but does need to contend with a poor gate. PAILLERON looks to make her debut here. She's been $7.00 into $4.20 early doors and has trialled up well also. MOON FLASH rounds out the numbers as a place chance only. Solid enough first-up run but this looks even tougher.

raceTips.comment: Beyond The Reef is well placed resuming over the 1100m and if able to reproduce the rating from her only start last preparation she will figure in the finish. The Bjorn Baker trained Pailleron has trialled well leading in and if able to reproduce that form on race day will be in the finish, maps to get a soft run from the inside draw.

Slander looks the pick of the two with the race fitness edge and positive draw. The Chris Waller-trained NUCLEAR PETE rounds out the numbers. Back-to-back quiet trials but he looks better than a $19 shot.

raceTips.comment: Not On My Watch Performed strongly when first up over 1100m at Gosford and would have taken considerable improvement off that performance, maps well from the inside draw saved for one sprint at them late. bestBets.overview: Another smart contest here. Good speed on up front which suggests horses should be able to run on. I expect the Nathan Doyle-trained LADY OF THE CASTLE to start much shorter. Given no real chance last start in a strong-rating race, gets a key jockey upgrade to Zac Lloyd on board and shouldn?t be more than 3L off the leaders. SPRIGHTLY AFFAIR is the danger but has come up rather short. Yes, brings metro form lines but has a lot of pressure and the wide gate to contend with here. I expect AT HER MERCY to bounce back to form. The right setup here with strong speed on up front and a solid map. SHALAA GOLD rounds out the numbers.

raceTips.comment: Mrs Falnders has been racing in good fashion and looks suited by the conditions of this contest. The mare has a sharp turn of foot and should be able to settle close enough to the speed before being asked for her effort. Shalaa Gold has displayed enough ability to remain firmly in contention and looks capable of giving a good account. The filly has tactical speed and should be able to secure a favourable position without doing too much work early. At Her Mercy has been competitive in similar company and possesses the strength to finish off her races solidly. The mare can be effective late if the tempo allows her to conserve enough energy for the straight.

bestBets.overview: Outstanding betting contest here. I loved the late sectional strength of the Matt Smith-trained MADE IN ITALY first-up. I like her also being kept to the shorter trips. She maps to land in behind what looks an average tempo and gets every chance to break through. CALL ME COACH is the best horse in the field but needs a lot of luck to offset the wide draw. Smart trials and has a future no doubt. Both NEVER KNOW and SEMINAL have claims also. Never Know was good behind Im Ya Huckleberry fresh and gets blinkers now, while Seminal has trialled up well and gets the key booking of Lloyd.

raceTips.comment: Never Know has shown enough ability in recent performances to make this an interesting challenge. The gelding can settle just behind the leading runners and should have the opportunity to build momentum at the right stage. His ability to finish strongly gives him a genuine chance of being involved in the final stages. The key will be getting clear running when the field straightens and allowing him to build through his gears.

bestBets.overview: Tricky end to the program. DIVINE SECRETS was heavily backed last time out when something wasn't right. Smart fresh run and I'm happy to trust that strong last-start SP. STALLONE has been saved for this contest. Progressive on-speed galloper who looks very well placed by the Baker camp. WALLACE STATION should take a lot out of his debut win. Out to 1400m is key but the poor gate is the worry. CONCRETE STORM goes in the mix but $3.00 seems very short. Third-up now and draws well. GLASTONBURY GIRL comes through a strong last-start contest. Fitness is no issue but the map looks to be.

raceTips.comment: The lightly raced Concrete Storm was a strong winner over 1400m last start and is now at peak fitness, maps to enjoy the run of the race stalking the leading pair throughout and saved for one sprint at them late. Stallone has performed well at two starts this preparation and is now set to peak, maps to get the run of the race stalking the leading pair throughout.
